notes.title: Loans Update is live
notes.content:
Hello Traders

We are continuing to develop the Coin Trader Simulator. Feedback for our previous version focused on early game mechanics, more specifically about unpreventable bankruptcies because of a lack of sources in the early game. Our newest update includes two main changes;


Free Skill Points

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531419/e01affdf1faa70777ef5b5b4dd5ee78b956ac47b.png[/img]

From now on, you will have three free skill points. You can use them to unlock another coin or acquire a skill to get money. It’s all up to you and your trading strategy. You will get extra skill points with each level, just as it is.



Loan

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531419/bfc0e89fc1e17a9007781bbaee871301efd5757d.png[/img]

We have been planning this new feature from the first day of the Coin Trader Simulator. From now on, you can borrow and invest with it under the “Personal.” But like the living cost debts, loan debts will increase each day with interest.

The total loan amount is limited to your house tier. By buying better houses, you can get more loan amounts.


Good luck and good earnings

notes.title: After the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello traders,

We experienced a devastating earthquake in our homeland, Turkey, on Feb 06. Professors specified that the earthquake was one of the greatest in human history; thousands of people died in Turkey and Syria, and tens of thousands were injured or became homeless. Some analysts report that about 13 million people are affected directly. We are still living through the shock of the disaster. As coffee++ games team, we also contribute to the aid campaigns and software initiatives to help survivors.

On the other hand, life continues somehow…

We also had a great Steam Next Fest on Feb 06-13 for Coin Trader Simulator. Thanks for all your feedback.

Feedbacks gather around two main issues;

[u]Living costs issue[/u]

In Coin Trader Simulator, each house has some living costs. Some of you complained that these costs are so massive and quickly sink free cash. 

We will not decrease living costs. In this inflationary environment, this will be so unrealistic! But we are working on a new living cost system; debts. With this new system, players will not have to pay their bills automatically, but bills will add to their debts at an interest rate. By that, players will still have free cash to trade. We think that this system will be a bit more challenging and exciting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43531419/f851843242f6054235b0291660c7b312f1024aca.png[/img]

[u]Lack of tools for early game[/u]

In Coin Trader Simulator, players at level 1 have only Bitcoin to trade; Market Sense and Influence skills are not unlocked, so some players give feedback that they have to wait only for Bitcoin’s rise. We are working on this situation, and we are testing several methods.

We also note some great ideas came from you about new features. We cannot promise to add all of them, but we are discussing each of them deeply.

By the way, do not forget to join our community;

[url=https://discord.gg/Qt6kSyhw]coffee++ games Discord[/url]

Thanks to all of you. Keep safe, keep happy, and keep gaming.

notes.title: 💰Don't Worry, Be Trader💰
notes.content:
We are excited to write down our first blog. We have been working on our game for a while and it will be 
available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 6 February 2023.

You’ll also be able to join the developer stream on February 6th, 2023. We are humbled by your continuous support from day one.


Everybody wants to get rich! Start with a 100$ christmas gift from your grandmother and a pathetic office at the basement of your parents’ house, invest in bitcoin, ethereum, tether or dogecoin. Be a better trader by leveling up.Sense trends or create your own ones. Buy the dip, sell the rip and rise to the top!

[h1]Sense Trends[/h1]
Get experience by each successful selling, and increase trend sensing abilities to predict which way the coin will move.

[h1]Pump & Dump[/h1]
Having Diamond Hands could be painful right? Why are you waiting for the rip to sell and earn some money? Use the Cheeper, the social media platform in Coin Trader Simulator, to pump your coin to the moon!

[h1]Houses[/h1]
It’s shameful to trade millions and still live with your parents, right? Buy better houses and become the crypto king.

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. We can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to jump in if you would like to reach us directly.

Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
